Levent

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Item Bundle
parts:
Sure, there is a design$constraints list input that can be used to specify groups of items that must be administered in sequence, regardless of the item selection criteria. Though it depends on how fine-grained you want to go with this type of presentation (similar information can be added via shadow testing, for example). 

Phil
